text:
alex: Quick heads-up: sched sim results are in. We tried slice-based packing with a 15% preempt budget. Results below.
maya: link to sim: https://redwood.sims/1954-slice-15pct
maya: tl;dr: evictions down 30% but tail latency for /realtime endpoints up ~18% when slices exceed 6 tenants.
alex: Can we tune preempt budget dynamically per-pool? Maybe use lower budget for realtime pool.
tj: I pushed a prototype that gatekeeps slice size by tenant-criticality. config snippet:
```
slice_max_tenants: 6
preempt_budget_pct:
  realtime: 5
  batch: 20
```
serena: Nice. What's the cost delta? finance asked for GPU-hour delta for Q3 ramp.
kai: Rough calc: opportunistic packing saves ~9% GPU-hours overall, but QoS miss increases SLO penalty risk for top 10% customers. Net cost savings ~4% after penalty model.
maya: Also saw fragmentation metric spike on nodes with mixed small/large jobs. Might need eviction smoothing (drip evictions) to avoid hotspots.
alex: Ops concern: if we lower realtime preempt to 5% packing will worsen for batch-heavy tenants. Can we run canary for us-west-2 only? infra-bot: canary started: group=us-west-2 slice-policy=v1 start=1954001300
tj: Good. Please monitor `eviction_rate`, `tail_p95_latency`, and `frag_index` on dashboard `infra/binpack/slice-v1`
serena: Action items: (1) tj -> adjust slice policy to 6/5/20 and deploy canary in us-west-2 (ETA 2h). (2) maya -> run cost model with penalty sensitivity and share numbers by EOD. (3) kai -> run frag sim with more realistic tenant sizes.
alex: If canary stable for 24h, we can roll to us-east-1 but keep realtime pinned. :thumbsup:
maya: noted. I'll post sim CSVs and a short doc with thresholds.
infra-bot: alert suppressed: eviction_spike in us-west-2 cleared at 1954001365
tj: I'll also add a fallback policy: if p95_realtime > 200ms for 10m, force rollback to packing=v0.
serena: thanks everyone. Revisit after 24h canary and cost numbers.
